title: 第3章 伴侣加成效果翻倍第4章 想让我当你干爷爷
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 夜色越发深沉。
沈云站了一会，直着的背又驼下去，太累了。
回到房间，抱着苏婉儿闭上眸子沉沉睡去。
老人稍微活动就累，好在怀中软玉能化解倦意。
梦里他长生不死、返老还童，携美人踏足北海玄冰，袖卷沧溟巨浪。
佳人青丝扫过手背，化作九天银河垂落，登仙之路呈现眼前。
就在沈云大喜，携美攀登之际。
忽而天裂声传来，虚空深处泛起遮天蔽日的鳞甲，那巨兽眸如两轮血月碾压而来，大口一张便吞了半边天。
“光怪陆离，好个吞天大梦！”
沈云惊觉时冷汗湿了中衣，肚子咕咕直叫，却感觉神清气爽。
【深度睡眠身心舒畅，福报+1】
“梦和现世是相反的，看来我要走大运。”
看向窗外，天光刚刚放亮。
护院们的晨练声隐约传来，而他躺着就能变强。
一旁的佳人还在熟睡，几缕青丝散落在白皙似玉的脸颊。
这一幕很美。
沈云却没有停下欣赏，迫不及待的打开古卷看了一眼。
不是大梦一场空。
古卷上又有了新的提示，昨日伴侣加成结算。
【今日共获得福报点10，满意度96%，加成9.6，额外获得福报点10】
苏婉儿在沈云心中的满意度接近满值，他又额外获得了十福报点。
沈云惊喜不已。
伴侣很重要，能让每日收获翻倍。
获得28点福报，其中足足十八点是道侣带来的。
【退休福报古卷：零阶（91000）】（消耗累计）
想要古卷升阶，算起来一个多月足以。
很快。
“可惜现在只有一个伴侣名额。”
沈云不是毛头小子，有着两世经历，分神片刻便回归现实。
起身洗漱。
账房走不开人，今天还要当值。
现在不是使用福报点的好时候，明天买了丹药，留一点给滚石拳，然后梭哈呼吸法！
听到沈云的声音，苏婉儿也醒了过来。
“夫君，你起床了，婉儿伺候你洗漱。”
content_en:
The night is getting darker.
Shen Yun stood for a while, his straight back hunched down again, he was too tired.
Returning to the room, she hugged Su Wan'er and closed her eyes and fell asleep.
The old man gets tired after a little exercise, but fortunately the nephrite jade in his arms can relieve his tiredness.
In the dream, he was immortal, rejuvenated, and set foot on the black ice of the North Sea with his beauty, his sleeves rolled up against the huge waves.
The beauty's black hair swept across the back of her hand, turning into the Milky Way falling from the sky, and the road to immortality appeared before her eyes.
Just when Shen Yun was overjoyed and climbed with beauty.
Suddenly, the sound of the sky cracking was heard, and scales covered the sky and sun appeared in the depths of the void. The giant beast's eyes were like two blood moons crushing in, and it swallowed half of the sky with its big mouth.
"It's so weird and bizarre, what a dream that swallows the sky!"
When Chen Yun woke up, his clothes were wet with cold sweat, his stomach growled, but he felt refreshed.
[Deep sleep, physical and mental comfort, blessing +1]
"Dreams and reality are opposite. It seems that I am going to have great luck."
Looking out the window, the sky has just brightened.
The faint sounds of the nurses' morning exercises could be heard, and he could become stronger just by lying down.
The beauty beside her was still sleeping soundly, with a few strands of black hair scattered on her fair and jade-like cheeks.
This scene is beautiful.
Chen Yun did not stop admiring it, and couldn't wait to open the ancient scroll and take a look.
It's not a big dream.
There is a new reminder on the ancient scroll, and the companion bonus was settled yesterday.
[A total of 10 blessing points were obtained today, with a satisfaction rate of 96%, a bonus of 9.6, and an additional 10 blessing points]
Su Wan'er's satisfaction in Shen Yun's heart was close to full, and he gained ten additional blessing points.
Shen Yun was pleasantly surprised.
Partners are important and can double your daily gains.
Obtained 28 points of blessings, of which a full 18 points were brought by Taoist companions.
[Ancient Scroll of Retirement Blessings: Level 0 (91000)] (accumulated consumption)
If you want to upgrade the ancient scroll, more than a month is enough.
soon.
"It's a pity that there is only one partner quota now."
Shen Yun is not a young boy. He has experienced two lives. He can be distracted for a moment and then return to reality.
Get up and wash up.
There is no one left in the accounting office, and I have to be on duty today.
Now is not a good time to use the blessing points. I will buy the elixir tomorrow, leave some for Rolling Stone Fist, and then do the Stud Breathing Technique!
Hearing Chen Yun's voice, Su Waner also woke up.
"Husband, get up. Wan'er will help you wash up."
title_en: Chapter 3 The partner bonus effect is doubled Chapter 4 You want me to be your godfather
